milestones.name: Repository Audit, Recovery & Branch Synchronization
milestones.evidence: Branched cleanly off origin/main (commit 2b3eae4). No secrets or customer credentials exposed in repository. Working commit ready for PR.

milestones.name: Authoritative Supabase PostgreSQL Persistence (Local JSON Eliminated)
milestones.evidence: PersistentDB refactored to treat Supabase PostgreSQL as authoritative. Silent JSON fallbacks prohibited in production mode. SQL migrations validated (20261108000000_init_schema.sql and 20261108000001_production_schema_v3_1.sql) with full multi-tenant RLS.

milestones.name: Self-Service Ordering Journey & Business Turnaround Timelines
milestones.evidence: Full journey (Discovery -> Builder -> Quote -> Checkout -> Intake -> Dashboard) verified. Authoritative turnaround days reconciled against owner KB: Meta (4d), Google (4d), LinkedIn (4d), 3-Platform Bundle (7d), WhatsApp (3d), Pixel (3d), Ad Creative (2d).

milestones.name: Official SSLCOMMERZ V4 Integration & Production Gating
milestones.evidence: Official SSLCOMMERZ Session API parameters, IPN callback verification, Val_ID replay protection, and minor poisha validation implemented. Gateway simulator gated with 403 Forbidden in production.

milestones.name: Client Dashboard & Admin Operations Hub
milestones.evidence: Client workspace (/dashboard) and staff operations hub (/admin) fully operational. Supports engineer assignments, finance manual MFS verification ledger, SLA clock countdown, and append-only audit trail.

milestones.evidence: Concept C Direct Commerce unified with Concept A Midnight Navy (#071525), Warm Ivory (#FFFCF5), and Champagne Gold (#D9B45E). English and Bengali dual-language toggling fully functional.
